name: Additional Container Cluster Roles
summary: An adversary may add additional roles or permissions to an adversary-controlled user or service account to maintain persistent access to a container orchestration system. For example, an adversary with sufficient permissions may create a RoleBinding or a ClusterRoleBinding to bind a Role or ClusterRole to a Kubernetes account. strategies.name: Suspicious RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding Assignment in Kubernetes

analytics.name: Analytic 1579
analytics.guidance: Detects assignment of high-privilege roles to user or service accounts via Kubernetes RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding objects, especially outside of CI/CD automation or from unknown IPs.
